title: CatalogRecord
responsibility: Stores revision-bound verification records in catalog_records through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.id
inputs.description: Stored row identity; the model passes it to the adapter without generating a key.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.commit
inputs.description: Git commit to which this stored record belongs.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.data
inputs.description: Structured payload retained by the adapter; no model code is executed to describe it.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.find
outputs.description: Promise of the matching catalog_records row, or null according to the adapter lookup result.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.findBy
outputs.description: Promise of catalog_records rows matching the supplied attribute filters.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.create
outputs.description: Promise of the catalog_records row returned by the adapter after creation.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.update
outputs.description: Promise of the updated catalog_records row, or null according to the adapter update result.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.delete
outputs.description: Promise of the adapter deletion result for the requested catalog_records row.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Adapter exceptions and promise rejections pass through unchanged; caller-provided field getters can also throw during argument copying.
